out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: observed heat sanitizing dish machine at 154-155F during inspection. Facility will utilize single service utensils and plates until repair is made.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. Please contact technician for repair and forward work order to EHS once repair is complete.
